customrecordcustomfield.label: Bank Account
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: The GL bank account used for reconciliation.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Subsidiary
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: Limit matching to this subsidiary. Leave blank for all subsidiaries.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Amount Tolerance
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: Maximum allowed amount difference when auto-matching.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Date Tolerance (days)
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: Maximum number of days between bank date and NetSuite date for auto-matching.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Approver
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: Employee who must approve all reconciliation proposals before they are applied.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Auto-suggest Matches on Import
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: When enabled, the best match candidate is automatically proposed when bank lines are imported (still requires approval).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Default Bank Fee Account
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: GL expense account used to post the variance difference when a payment is created with an amount tolerance gap (Match with Variance).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Default Suspense Account
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: GL suspense account used as a quick-select default in the Manual Matching UI for unknown or unidentified transactions.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Default Department
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: Default department applied to all Journal Entry lines created by Bank Match. Required when Department is a mandatory segment in your NetSuite account.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Default Class
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: Default class (classification) applied to all Journal Entry lines created by Bank Match. Required when Class is a mandatory segment in your NetSuite account.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Default Location
customrecordcustomfield.helptext: Default location applied to all Journal Entry lines created by Bank Match. Required when Location is a mandatory segment in your NetSuite account.
